entries.title: Psalms 97:1
segments: ¶The Lord is King, let the earth have joy; let all the sea-lands be glad.

entries.title: Psalms 97:2
segments: Dark clouds are round him; his kingdom is based on righteousness and right judging.

entries.title: Psalms 97:3
segments: Fire goes before him, burning up all those who are against him round about.

entries.title: Psalms 97:4
segments: His bright flames give light to the world; the earth saw it with fear.

entries.title: Psalms 97:5
segments: The mountains became like wax at the coming of the Lord, at the coming of the Lord of all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 97:6
segments: The heavens gave out the news of his righteousness, and all the people saw his glory.

entries.title: Psalms 97:7
segments: Shamed be all those who give worship to images, and take pride in false gods; give him worship, all you gods.

entries.title: Psalms 97:8
segments: ¶Zion gave ear and was glad; and the daughters of Judah were full of joy, because of your decisions, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 97:9
segments: For you, Lord, are most high over the earth; you are lifted up over all other gods.

entries.title: Psalms 97:10
segments: You who are lovers of the Lord, be haters of evil; he keeps the souls of his saints; he takes them out of the hand of sinners.

entries.title: Psalms 97:11
segments: Light is shining on the lovers of righteousness, and for the upright in heart there is joy.

entries.title: Psalms 97:12
segments: Be glad in the Lord, you upright men; praising the memory of his holy name.
